name: GEN1 structure-specific endonuclease
pathways: double-strand break repair via homologous recombination

function.text: GEN1 encodes flap endonuclease GEN homolog 1. Annotated molecular activities include 5'-flap endonuclease activity and protein homodimerization activity. It participates in double-strand break repair via homologous recombination and replication fork processing.
